verdict.rationale: stagewise is an agentic IDE, so a sandboxed test environment is a fair question, but the evidence documents no sandbox or isolated environment that keeps the agent away from production data. Diff review with undo/redo, design previews and local dev-server previews are review and rollback features, not sandbox isolation. A community comment that it "should be sandboxed by default" suggests agents run directly on the host, though it is not formal documentation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
